# runtimeconditions.io/x/google/analytics

Use this extension when your website or web app sends events to Google Analytics from the browser.

In a Condition, you list the kinds of events that your site sends, such as page views. You also give the
environment variable that holds the Google Analytics measurement ID, the ID that starts with G-. The
platform then sets up a Google Analytics property and puts its measurement ID in that variable.

```sh
go get runtimeconditions.io/x/google/analytics@v0.2.0
```

Runtime Conditions extension: https://runtimeconditions.io/extensions/google/analytics/0.2.0/runtimeconditions.extension.yaml

## GoogleAnalytics

`analytics.GoogleAnalytics` declares a `google.analytics` Condition.

Your workload sends events to Google Analytics.

Example: a website that records each page view, and reads its measurement ID from GA_MEASUREMENT_ID.

```go
analytics.GoogleAnalytics(
	analytics.Web{
		Events: analytics.Events{
			analytics.EventsItemPageView,
		},
	},
	analytics.Configuration{
		Env: analytics.Env{
			map[string]any{"name": "GA_MEASUREMENT_ID", "property": "measurementId"},
		},
	},
)
```

In a Profile, this declares:

```yaml
kind: google.analytics
interface:
  type: web
  events: [page_view]
configuration:
  env:
    - property: measurementId
      name: GA_MEASUREMENT_ID
```

## Configuration

`analytics.Configuration` sets the `configuration` field of `google.analytics` Conditions with interface type `web`.

How your workload gets the Google Analytics measurement ID. List the environment variable that holds
it, with property set to measurementId.

The full API, with every type, field and constant documented, is in the Go package documentation.
